name: Emil de Lucia
source:
Crown Princess of the Duchy of Lucia, Pilot of the Pegasus Dragoon.

A harsh and irritable feline, and the eldest daughter of the royal family. Has a strict sense of judgement towards other people and is quick to anger, but will show an unexpected kindness and patience to those she feels a sense of devotion towards. Doesn't particularly enjoy her position as royalty, and finds those who flaunt their status an object of disgust.

Sign: Scorpio
Favourite Food: Meat.
Hobbies: Viewing old films, Gambling, Horse riding.
Likes: Doting on her younger sister, Honest people.
Dislikes: More or less everything.

[From [url=https://coquettedragoon.com/cast/]official website[/url]]
